meta.title: eRFX Auction stage with Duration 60 Mins
gaps: Verify by comparing the displayed Bidding Starts At and Bidding Ends At timestamps that the interval is exactly 60 minutes.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify by comparing the displayed Bidding Starts At and Bidding Ends At timestamps that the interval is exactly 60 minutes.

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Keep the project configured with its single Auction stage.
Configure the Auction stage before selecting its template and items.
Add the one required auction item.
Populate the pricing sheet so the event is publishable.
Invite two QA test vendors as required by the scenario.
Verify that publishing reached the real project page.
Confirm Project Details exposes the bidding end field for the published auction.
Confirm no application error is shown after publication.
